summary: Frontend-only font regression test for Home page. All 4 new font assignments verified successfully via computed style inspection: (1) FUTUR SOCCER CUP logo uses Plane Crash with planeCrashSafe normalization rendering grunge stencil glyphs; (2) Torneo Internacional uses Natura Script (fallback Allura, italic); (3) All 8 navbar links (INICIO, NOSOTROS, EVENTOS, ESTADÍSTICAS, NOTICIAS, CONTÁCTO, INGRESO, REGISTRO) declare Neo Sans Std font-family; (4) OCTUBRE/DICIEMBRE month pills declare Neo Sans Std with blue text on white. Plane Crash regression elements (hero-edition, hero-year, region-title, footer-heading) still rendering correctly. document.fonts.check('80px Plane Crash') returns true. No font-related JS errors.

issues: Neo Sans Std is a commercial font (no TTF uploaded) — expected. However, the secondary fallback 'Exo 2' is also not loaded (document.fonts.check returned false). Browser falls back further down the chain to Barlow/Inter/system sans-serif. Visual rendering remains a clean modern sans-serif, but if 'Exo 2' is meant to be the actual rendered font per request, ensure Exo 2 is imported in /app/frontend/public/index.html via Google Fonts link. Acceptable per agent_to_agent_context_note that fallback is expected.
